day_titles.6: Ta dzong and rinpung dzong and tiger's nest hike

1: Arrival at Bagdogra or Siliguri and transfer to Phuentsholing
Border formalities at the Bhutan Gate
Check in and the rest of the day free
2: Breakfast, then north into the hills towards Thimphu
The Chukha dam and the Wang Chhu gorge on the way
Optional: the Zorig Chusum school of arts
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
3: Breakfast, then out into the capital
The Memorial Chorten and the Buddha Dordenma
Tashichho Dzong and the takin preserve
4: Breakfast, then east over the Dochula pass
The hundred and eight chortens at the top
Punakha Dzong between the Pho and Mo rivers
The long suspension bridge over the water
5: Breakfast, then west down the valley to Paro
Terraced fields and farmhouses the whole way
The National Museum in the old watchtower
Rinpung Dzong and the Drukgyel ruins
6: Breakfast, then out into the Paro valley
The round watchtower holding the National Museum
Rinpung Dzong on the slope above the river
The climb up the pine slope to Taktsang
The monastery wedged into the cliff face
7: Breakfast, then the long run back south
Down through the Chukha gorge to the plains
Optional: Zangto Pelri Lhakhang in the town
Arrival transfer and check in for the night
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Border formalities and transfer to Siliguri

expert.name: Tenzin
expert.quote: The middle tier of our eight day circuit: four star hotels throughout, at a long way below the five star price.
expert.tip: Super deluxe is the sweet spot in Bhutan. The jump from three to four star is big and from four to five star is mostly the view.

summary: 8 days through Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro, with 7 nights, Breakfast and dinner each day and a licensed Bhutanese guide: the thimphu sightseeing tour, the punakha sightseeing tour, the paro sightseeing tour, the ta dzong and rinpung dzong.
included: Included: 7 nights across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, Paro with Breakfast and dinner each day; all land transfers by private vehicle; the Thimphu sightseeing tour; the Punakha sightseeing tour; the Paro sightseeing tour; the Ta Dzong and Rinpung Dzong; the Hike to the Tiger's Nest; a licensed Bhutanese guide; permits and the sustainable development fee as quoted.
not_included: Not included: international and domestic flights; lunches and any meals not listed; monument entrance fees where not stated; travel insurance; personal expenses.
